sentence_stem: My sister usually wakes up early,
correct_completion: and she makes breakfast for us.
full_sentence: My sister usually wakes up early, and she makes breakfast for us.
acceptable_variants: and she prepares breakfast for us.
and she cooks breakfast for the family.

options.text: and she go to school by bus.
options.why_wrong: With 'she', the verb needs an -s ending: 'goes', not 'go'.
This changes the subject to 'I', so it does not continue the idea about 'my sister'.

options.text: and she makes breakfast for us.
and she make breakfast every day.

explanation: The stem uses a subject and verb in the present simple. The completion must use the third person singular form of the verb, which ends in -s or -es, and must continue the same subject.
